findings.title: Wait for the reader to finish before asserting its failures
findings.body: Setting deletedAll does not wait for the reader's in-flight groups request to complete. That request can fail and add its exception after the empty-list assertion has already passed, so this regression test can miss the concurrent-access failure it is intended to detect. Retain the reader thread and join it before asserting, and signal shutdown in a finally block so a failed deletion does not leave the reader running indefinitely.
